retired.reason: Merged into q-passkey-smart-account-architecture. Same knowledge as q-passkey-smart-account-architecture (CAP-0051 P-256 primitive is not full WebAuthn validation; __check_auth binds the challenge). The survivor's accepted soroban-a rewrite contains neither absorbed item, so the orchestrator must add them when applying, as answer clauses rather than new key facts: 'WebAuthn also permits algorithms other than P-256' and 'a separate G account submits and pays fees; the C account only authorizes'. Both are already in this case's verified golden; no fact changes.
